en: The postcard features a monochrome photograph of a small town or village surrounded by forested hills, labeled 'Bad Pyrmont-Friedenthal.' On the right side, there is a colored illustration showing deer and a bird among trees and ferns, adding a naturalistic and picturesque touch. The reverse side bears the word 'Postkarte' (German for 'postcard'), fields for writing an address, and a stamp of the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' There are handwritten numbers and short words without personal messages.
